quotes.quote: GPT‑5.5 is our strongest agentic coding model to date.
our internal frontier eval for long-horizon coding tasks with a median estimated human completion time of 20 hours
which evaluates real-world GitHub issue resolution
Across all three evals, GPT‑5.5 improves on GPT‑5.4’s scores while using fewer tokens.
Evals of GPT were run with reasoning effort set to xhigh and were conducted in a research environment, which may provide slightly different output from production ChatGPT in some cases.
Update on April 24, 2026: GPT‑5.5 and GPT‑5.5 Pro are now available in the API.
Scores across all 34 tasks. Each model runs 5 trials per task with a 20-hour budget.
long-horizon coding and cross-branch reasoning are exactly where Expert-SWE (OpenAI’s internal benchmark) shows a 5-point lift over GPT-5.4
GPT-5.5 and GPT-5.4 both yielding control mid-task or declining work that was explicitly requested
